title: Google: wire up thinkingLevel mapping + missing finish reasons
description: Two small Google provider gaps: (1) Gemini thinkingLevel mapping is not implemented — the wire type is ready but the mapping from StreamOptions thinking budget to the Gemini thinkingLevel field is absent. (2) 4 image-related finish reasons (BLOCKLIST, PROHIBITED_CONTENT, SPII, IMAGE_SAFETY) are missing from the Google provider's stop reason mapping and P3 completeness test.

comments.author: Danny Cosson
comments.text: R1 review complete — Approved. 1 P3 finding (cosmetic: empty string default for unrecognized thinking levels). No changes needed. See docs/reviews/aiag-aps-r1-review-reviewer-sea.md
